item.title: Tesla Robotaxi reaches COTA for the US Grand Prix and now runs until 1 a.m. in Austin
item.description: Ahead of the Formula 1 weekend, Tesla's Robotaxi app in Austin added the Circuit of the Americas to its service area and pushed last call to 1 a.m. Here is what changed and why race weekend is a real test.

item.title: Tesla's Summer Update 2026.26: every feature explained, from Grok commands to Preferred Routes
item.description: Tesla's big summer software update added more Grok voice control, a rear-screen lock for kids, smarter navigation and app features. What each feature does and who gets it.

item.title: Musk's new deadlines: a checklist of everything promised on Tesla's Q3 2026 call
item.description: From Cybercab rides in Dallas to Optimus deliveries and Terafab's first chip, these are the dates Elon Musk and his team gave in October 2026. We will use this list to check what actually happens.

item.title: Did Musk's politics cost Tesla a million sales? What the study found, and what has changed since
item.description: A widely cited economic study estimated that Elon Musk's political profile cost Tesla more than a million US sales. What it measured, its limits, and how Tesla's sales look in 2026.

item.title: Musk's promises versus reality: the Roadster, the Semi and robotaxis, year by year
item.description: Elon Musk's timelines are famous for slipping, yet many of the products do arrive. A factual look at what was promised and when it actually happened.

item.title: Musk the trillionaire: why SpaceX, not Tesla, now drives his fortune, and why that matters to Tesla
item.description: SpaceX's IPO made Elon Musk the first person worth more than $1 trillion. How his wealth shifted, where his time goes, and the questions it raises for Tesla shareholders.

item.title: Musk's 'trillion-dollar' Tesla pay package explained: the 12 milestones, and how far along they are
item.description: Shareholders approved Elon Musk's new pay plan in November 2025. What he has to achieve, why the numbers differ so much, and what Tesla's 2026 proxy says about progress.

item.title: Tesla's factories after Q3 2026: record rates, an Optimus line in Fremont and a Semi plant in Nevada
item.description: The third-quarter call gave a rare overview of Tesla's production network. What is running, what is ramping, and what is still being built, factory by factory.

item.title: Giga Mexico three and a half years on: what happened to Tesla's factory near Monterrey
item.description: In 2023, Tesla announced a large factory in Nuevo León. It was slowed, then paused. A look at what was promised, why it stalled, and how it fits Tesla's plans today.

item.title: Giga Berlin raises pay by up to 5% as it pushes for 7,500 cars a week, but IG Metall wants more
item.description: Tesla's Grünheide workers get another raise from October. What changes, how it compares with the union's demands, and what it says about the plant's production push.

item.title: Giga Berlin plans a second hall twice the size of the first, aiming for up to a million cars a year
item.description: Tesla wants to add a 536,000 m² building north of its Grünheide plant. What is planned, when construction could start, and why it will take years.

item.title: Tesla has its best month ever in Europe: September registrations up 72.5%, Model Y and Model 3 finish one-two
item.description: Official ACEA figures show 68,776 new Teslas registered across Europe in September 2026, beating BYD for the month. Model Y and Model 3 were the continent's two best-selling cars.

item.title: Tesla is building its own AI maps for FSD, starting with v15: what changes for speed limits, routes and parking
item.description: On the Q3 call, Tesla's AI chief said FSD should stop relying on outside maps. A new fleet-trained mapping and navigation system arrives with FSD v15, first for the start and end of trips.

item.title: Prufrock explained: how The Boring Company's tunnel machine works, and where Tesla comes in
item.description: Prufrock launches straight from the surface, lines the tunnel while it digs and moves to the next site on a trailer. How it differs from classic tunnel boring, the targets, and the Tesla links.

item.title: The Boring Company bets on the Gulf: Dubai Loop, an Abu Dhabi study and UAE money
item.description: The UAE led a $3 billion funding round, Dubai has signed for a pilot Loop and Abu Dhabi has started a study. What is agreed, what is only being explored, and how Teslas fit in.

item.title: A Boring Company tunnel for Morgan's Wonderland: Prufrock-5 arrives in San Antonio
item.description: A 900,000-pound tunnel boring machine is waiting at an inclusive theme park campus in San Antonio. What the project is, who pays, and what still needs approval.

item.title: Nashville's Music City Loop: two machines digging, a third about to start, first segment due late 2026
item.description: The Boring Company's Nashville tunnel is speeding up. Where the Loop should go, how far along it is, and how it links to Tesla.

item.title: The Boring Company wants to move freight through its tunnels, using trucks built from Tesla parts
item.description: A converted tunnel truck with Tesla Model 3 batteries and motors now carries a standard shipping container. What The Boring Company showed, what it did not say, and why it matters.

item.title: Starlink V3 explained: why the new satellites need Starship, and what a 100 times bigger network would change
item.description: SpaceX has launched its first third-generation Starlink satellites and plans a booster and ship catch on the next Starship flight. What V3 is, the targets, and the link to connected and driverless cars.

item.title: Using a Starlink Mini in your Tesla: power, placement and costs for road trips and camping
item.description: A Starlink Mini can give you internet in places where your Tesla has no signal. How much power it uses from the battery, where to put it, what it costs, and the rules to keep in mind.

item.title: Starlink and Tesla today: where the two already meet, from Superchargers to the Cybercab
item.description: There is no Starlink option in the Tesla configurator, yet the two already work together in several places. An overview of what exists now, and what is still only an idea.

item.title: Starlink Mobile gets more spectrum: what SpaceX's phone network could mean for Tesla's connected cars
item.description: The FCC approved another spectrum purchase for SpaceX's direct-to-phone network. Here is what Starlink Mobile is, when it is due, and why Tesla owners might care.

item.title: Starlink reaches 13.6 million subscribers: the Q3 numbers and the V3 satellites that come next
item.description: SpaceX's latest results show Starlink growing fast and preparing a much bigger third-generation network. What that means for cars, including Teslas, that may one day connect by satellite.

item.title: SpaceX on the stock market: the record IPO explained, and what it means for Tesla shareholders
item.description: SpaceX listed on Nasdaq in June 2026 in the largest IPO ever. The price, the valuation, Musk's voting control, and the ways Tesla is tied to its sister company.

item.title: SpaceX's Q3 2026 results: revenue nearly triples and a $4.4 billion profit, a day before Tesla
item.description: SpaceX reported its second quarter as a listed company just before Tesla's results. The key numbers, what drove them, and why they matter for the Tesla-SpaceX merger debate.

item.title: Noise, turbines and home buyouts: the fight around SpaceXAI's Colossus data centres
item.description: Next to Memphis, in Southaven, Mississippi, Elon Musk's AI company now offers to buy homes near its power plant while residents sue over turbine noise. What is going on, and where Tesla fits in.

item.title: Grok Bot and 1.7 GW of compute: what SpaceX's AI division reported, and why Tesla should care
item.description: SpaceX now reports Grok and its other AI products as a separate 'Super Intelligence' segment. The first numbers, Musk's bold targets, and the link to Grok in Tesla cars.

item.title: How Tesla Megapacks power xAI's Colossus: about $1 billion in batteries since 2024
item.description: SpaceX's IPO filing revealed how much xAI spent on Tesla batteries for its AI data centres. The numbers, why a supercomputer needs Megapacks, and what it means for Tesla Energy.

item.title: What happened to xAI? How Grok's maker became SpaceXAI in 2026
item.description: In one year xAI was bought by SpaceX, lost its separate identity, bought Cursor and was renamed twice. A timeline, and what it means for Grok in your Tesla.

item.title: Tesla's $2 billion xAI bet: from a failed shareholder vote to a stake in SpaceX
item.description: Shareholders did not back an xAI investment, yet Tesla put in $2 billion anyway. Weeks later xAI became part of SpaceX. Here is how that money ended up as SpaceX shares.
